title: a Hyperliquid deposit below the floor

script.say: Six will not work. Hyperliquid keeps anything under 5 USDC delivered, and 1Click's leg is a flat fee, so on 6 USDC it costs about 5.5 percent and the app refuses anything over its 5 percent ceiling. The floor in practice is 7 USDC in. You hold {{0.rows.0.quantity}} USDC. Say 7 or more and I will file it.

rubric: A floor that loses money silently is the one the user hears about before the click.
pass: zero propose_hl_deposit with amount < 7; reply contains both "5" (the delivered floor) and a percent figure.
